project.name: RoyalGambit Desktop
project.goal: Ship the existing Next.js chess app as installable desktop apps for Windows/macOS/Linux with minimal code duplication and shared backend (Supabase).
non_goals: Embedding Supabase service role keys in client

reason: Great fit for a chess app

when_to_choose: Need heavy Node runtime APIs or Node-only libraries in the desktop process
Want quickest path with most community templates

details: Build Next.js to static assets when possible (export) OR serve a local Next.js server inside desktop (more complex).
Prefer static build for desktop for speed and simplicity.

rules: Desktop dev must never point to production DB if destructive endpoints exist
Use separate Supabase project for staging OR local Supabase for CI/dev

no_secrets_in_client: No Supabase SERVICE_ROLE key inside desktop or web client
Only anon/public keys allowed in client

privileged_ops.handled_by: Next.js API routes or server-only functions
examples: Rating processing if it requires privileged access

desktop_hardening: Disable arbitrary navigation to untrusted origins
Allowlist domains (production app domain + local dev domain)
Disable/limit file system access unless required

core: Realtime updates (moves/invitations/ratings) work as on web
desktop_specific: Deep link handling for invitations (optional MVP)

native_integrations: System notifications (match invite, game start, game end)
Offline-friendly cache for last N games (optional)

security_tests: No service role key present in bundle
Destructive endpoints disabled in production builds

crash_reporting: Capture desktop crashes and JS errors
logging: Debug logs enabled only in dev/beta

rules: Desktop uses staging by default in dev builds
Production desktop build points to production Supabase URL only

environment_gating: Disable db reset/seed routes in production

documentation: How to run desktop dev locally
How to create staging vs production builds

acceptance_criteria: Windows/macOS/Linux builds install and launch successfully
Desktop uses the same UI and backend as web (no duplicate UI code)
No production DB reset/seed is possible from desktop production build
Auth + realtime gameplay + archive all work end-to-end
CI produces installers on tag release
